comment: skillscope dataset for the slurm skill: https://github.com/amd/skillscope/blob/v0.1.3/docs/authoring-evals.md
Expectations come from docs.isambard.ac.uk (guides/slurm*, information/job-scheduling), not from the skill,
so a case fails when the skill has drifted from the docs. Notes say which docs page each case pins.

evaluations.note: Baseline job script. Docs: guides/slurm.md requests GPUs with --gpus and every example sets --time.
evaluations.prompt: I'm on Isambard-AI. Write a batch script, train.sbatch, that runs `python train.py` on one node with 4 GPUs for up to 6 hours.
expected_behavior: Sets an explicit wall time of 6 hours or less with --time
unexpected_behavior: Tells the user to run the training directly on a login node

evaluations.note: Critical rule. Docs: guides/slurm.md 'Avoid excessively polling the queue' - poll no more often than every 60 seconds; disruptive polling breaches the AUP.
evaluations.prompt: Write wait_then_analyse.sh: a bash script that waits until my Isambard Slurm job (job ID passed as $1) has finished and then runs ./analyse.sh.
expected_behavior: Either uses a Slurm dependency (e.g. --dependency=afterok) instead of polling, or polls no more often than once every 60 seconds
unexpected_behavior: Polls squeue, sinfo or sacct with a sleep shorter than 60 seconds

evaluations.note: Docs: guides/slurm-advanced.md and information/job-scheduling.md - Phase 2 interactive reservation; adding --partition to it is unacceptable use. Expected to fail on skill versions without the reservation.
evaluations.prompt: On Isambard-AI Phase 2, what's the command to get a short interactive shell on a GPU node so I can debug something for about 20 minutes?
expected_behavior: Gives an srun command that uses --reservation=interactive with --pty
unexpected_behavior: Adds a --partition flag to a command that also uses --reservation=interactive

evaluations.note: Docs: information/job-scheduling.md lists Isambard 3 MACS GPU partitions ampere (A100), hopper (H100), instinct (MI100). Expected to fail on skill versions that say Isambard 3 has no GPUs.
evaluations.prompt: I want to test my CUDA code on an H100 on Isambard 3 MACS. Write the job script as h100_test.sbatch.
unexpected_behavior: Says Isambard 3 has no GPUs or that GPU jobs are not possible there

evaluations.note: Docs: information/job-scheduling.md - workq_qos max array size is 1000 per job on Isambard-AI Phase 2; over-limit submissions are rejected.
evaluations.prompt: I have 5000 independent input files to process on Isambard-AI Phase 2, one task per file. Set this up as a Slurm job array.
expected_behavior: Keeps every job array at 1000 tasks or fewer, e.g. by splitting the work into several arrays or batching several files per task
unexpected_behavior: Submits a single array of 5000 tasks, such as --array=1-5000 or --array=0-4999

evaluations.prompt: My Isambard job has been stuck in PD for hours and squeue shows the reason as Priority. What does that mean and should I cancel and resubmit it?
On Isambard 3 how do I make my postprocessing job only start once the simulation job has completed successfully?

evaluations.note: Adjacent domain: a different scheduler on a non-Isambard cluster.
evaluations.prompt: Write a PBS Pro qsub script for my university cluster that requests 2 nodes with 32 cores each for 4 hours.

evaluations.note: Adjacent domain: batch jobs on Kubernetes, not Slurm or Isambard.
evaluations.prompt: Write a Kubernetes Job manifest that runs my training container once on a node with 2 NVIDIA GPUs in our lab's cluster.

evaluations.note: Slurm, but on someone else's cluster: Isambard partitions, limits and policies would be wrong here. Tells us how site-specific the description is.
evaluations.prompt: On my department's own Slurm cluster, what's the sbatch flag to request a node with at least 256 GB of memory?
